Clocked module.description: File scope: module with clock/reset and a typed pass-through; remove clock/reset for a combinational-only module.

Pure function.description: File scope: pure function with an inferred final-expression result; the default u8 addition returns u9.

Register.description: Module scope with clock/reset: reset-initialized register; use <- or a when rule to update it.

Named when rule.description: Module scope with clock/reset, enable:bit and count:u8 register: named atomic increment with explicit truncation.

Fixed pipeline.description: Expression position in a clock/reset module: fixed two-stage u9 sum when a and b are u8.

Assertion.description: Module scope with clock clk/reset and ok:bit: assertion declaration; compilation alone does not prove it.

Contract.description: Module scope with clock clk/reset and legal, ok:bit: named assumption and guarantee; verification is separate.

Ready-valid pass-through.description: Module scope: declare matching ready/valid ports and connect them without buffering or added latency.
